actions.name: SELECT_AND_FAVORITE
actions.sideEffect: Selection is local; favorites use authenticated UserFavorite.UserID and shipment-distribute-products namespace only. 품종(CounName::FlowerName) favorites use the same UserFavorite table under shipment-distribute-groups (FilterData {groupKey}); they are week independent, preselect the first favorite group present in the selected week until the user picks a group, and never write ERP ledgers. Country favorites use authenticated shipment-distribute-countries settings, no ERP writes.

actions.name: CONFIRMED_SCOPE_SAVE_CYCLE
actions.sideEffect: Before a product-tab or customer-tab save, GET type=fixedScopes (SELECT only, existing getProductScopeFixedRows per changed ProdKey) reports each product's CountryFlower and whether it is confirmed in this OrderYear+week. The customer-tab batch sends only rows whose quantity/cost changed (or pending-order rows), so the unfix scope is limited to the changed products' CountryFlowers and unrelated groups confirmed in a later week cannot block it. A separate purpose=badge read of the same SELECT drives the on-screen 🔒확정 markers only. No confirmed group: save exactly as before. Confirmed group: after explicit user confirmation, the existing lib/fixCycleClient runEditWithFixCycle unfixes only those CountryFlowers (explicit screen orderYear, force=false, stockProdKeys = changed products), runs the same order registration and batch distribute save, then refixes even when the save fails. Unfix failure restores already-unfixed weeks and writes nothing. A confirmed product with blank CountryFlower stops before any write. CONFIRMED_WEEK_EDIT_SAFETY_CHECKLIST C-1/C-3/C-10 preserved; server isFix guards unchanged. History: each unfix/refix request carries cycleSource=distribute-save, appended (sanitized, string only) to the existing AppLog shipmentFix unfix_start/fix_start lines next to uid; native usp_ShipmentFix/usp_ShipmentFixCancel keep writing StockHistory and flipping sd.isFix/sm.isFix themselves inside the per-CountryFlower withTransaction (failure throws and rolls back); the distribute save keeps its SystemActionLog snapshot. No new table.

actions.name: EXE_STYLE_SELECTION_AND_PAIR_VIEW
actions.sideEffect: Week (±3 major, sub-week), product and customer selection are buttons with data-ai-verify markers; the 업체정보 tab may show two customers side by side and move draft quantity (all, or a per-row partial amount) between them on screen only. Moving into a customer without an OrderDetail row for that product creates a pending row; on save the page first registers that order through the existing POST /api/orders (additive, OutUnit quantity = distributed quantity) and only then runs the batch distribute save, so no ghost shipment is written. A source row moved down to 0 keeps its OrderDetail untouched; a pending row moved back to 0 registers nothing.

actions.name: SAVE_ABSOLUTE_QUANTITY
actions.sideEffect: Existing native OutUnit conversion, Amount/Vat and ShipmentDate synchronization, farm/fixed protection preserved. Quantity edit snapshot is inserted into SystemActionLog inside the same verified transaction; failure rolls back. Zero deletes leave no fake detail row and retain immutable before/after audit.

actions.name: READ_SHARED_HISTORY
actions.sideEffect: Read-only DISTRIBUTE history in paste menu; never treat absolute edits as ADD/CANCEL or source delivery evidence.

criteria.productOrder: ProdName A-Z in every product selector/list, including favorites; never favorite-first or relevance-rank reorder.
criteria.keyboard: Visible Ctrl+Alt+1/2/3/4, Ctrl+Enter query, quantity Enter next visible enabled quantity (last row focuses Save without posting), and Ctrl+S current-tab save (품목 tab: product rows; 업체 tab: customer 1 and optional customer 2 rows in one batch). Ctrl+S with no draft change posts nothing and logs '변경 없음, 저장 생략'; every save result is appended to the on-screen save log. Native numeric arrows retained; Ctrl+S always prevents browser Save and cannot write while distribution/customer reads, fixed/SP/day saves, history/validation/SP/success modal, repeat, or IME composition. Natural Tab, arrow selection, Enter/Space, and Escape focus return remain available.
criteria.durability: Only verified successful quantity changes get immutable transaction audit, with exact scope, before/after and OutUnit. Existing0-to0 deletion creates no invalid audit.
criteria.privacy: New audit allowlists business fields; no raw chat, token or editGuard. Existing general request telemetry unchanged.
criteria.downstream: No new Estimate, StockHistory or WebProfitReport writes; native amount conversion and fixed protection unchanged. Read-only estimate visibility/amount/date and confirmed-sales evidence recorded in work plan.
criteria.viewport: 1920x1080 CSS100%, plus smaller widths; page primary scrolling and accessible popups.
criteria.price: Quantity-only saves preserve native customer Cost, including zero; never substitute Product.Cost when row.Cost exists.
criteria.catalogSearch: Group picker includes all active Product CounName+FlowerName regardless of year/week/order/shipment existence. Product-tab nonblank search merges active catalog by ProdKey, preserves selected-week quantities, matches country/flower/name and sorts A-Z; blank search keeps selected-week list. SELECT only; saves retain existing preflight and writers. Catalog-only products must also pass the selection whitelist, including empty 45-03 product lists. Header picker remains usable with zero current-week products and loads the same active catalog on open. Existing positive order registration precedes shipment writes.
criteria.countryGrouping: 국가(UserFavorite shipment-distribute-countries version1 countries)와 품종(shipment-distribute-groups)의 즐겨찾기 교집합을 국가 제목 아래 한 번만 표시. 설정이 없을 때만 기존 즐겨찾기 품종의 국가를 표시하는 이행정책; 명시[]는 빈 상태 유지. 전체보기에서 국가/품종 별도 설정. 위쪽 중복 즐겨찾기 버튼 제거. 계정변경시 모두 비움. 표시변경은 분배 초안 보존.
